title: Rahul Gandhi Applauds Student Protests: A Reflection of Youth's Voice
description: In a recent address, Rahul Gandhi praised the student protests surrounding the NEET paper leak, viewing them as a vital expression of youth sentiment. Gandhi shared insights from conversations with students, highlighting their views on education, knowledge, and humility. His remarks sparked a lively debate in the Lok Sabha, reflecting broader concerns about the education system. This article delves into Gandhi's thoughts and the implications of the protests.
